subject: [hw] opus-ios start: phone integration (launchd/txn/selftest/probe); first phone cycle can be selftest-only, no kernel change
body:
Plan (host only; the main session flashes):
 (a) n2vcd_selftest (gpu/hwcodec/ios/, links IVs ios-lib + T02 fake hw): 4 GiB PROT_NONE reservation (and the largest one that fits if not), _Thread_local on 2 threads, guest SIGSEGV -> STOP_FAULT -> recover, interpreted MIPS on 2 threads, then n2vhost_start on the REAL vendor files with the fake hw (bring-up to M-b/M-c on iOS). Needs NO kernel change: it can go in the very next transaction on the current kernel. This is item 9 of CRITICAL_PATH.
 (b) transaction payload-vcodec: /usr/local/libexec/{vcodecd,n2vcd_selftest,n2vcd_probe}, /usr/local/lib/n2vendor/{bin/vpud,lib/*.so} (from the PC copy, sha-checked, never committed), launchd jobs in /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist (com.nord2.vcodecd, com.nord2.vcodec-selftest, com.nord2.vcodec-probe), each gated by a file in /private/var/db, logs N2VCD/N2VCDT/N2VCDP to /dev/console = kernel log.
 (c) n2vcd_probe: boot-time one-shot client on the frozen relay ABI: HELLO, OPEN avc1 640x480, 10 frames of a synthetic NV12 pattern, Annex B saved to /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec/out/, hex of the first bytes on the console.
Sandbox/AMFI facts [V]: SWEET registers a permissive "Sandbox" MAC policy with no vnode_check_open hook (build/autotest/q10at3/kernel/stage/bsd/kern/sweet_amfi.c:763-779), so a device open is decided by DAC only; mediaserverd runs as mobile (launchd.plist) and already opens the 0666 /dev/redwood-camera; the relay minor 1 is 0666 too -> reachable from mediaserverd and any app. AMFI stub marks every binary signed (platform if on the root fs): ad-hoc linker signature is enough (videoprobe precedent).
